proposed.text: Under RA 9266 IRR Section 18, how long does a Certificate of Registration remain in force and effect?

options.text: Until withdrawn, suspended, or revoked according to the Act.
Only for one year after oath-taking.
Only until the next LEA is administered.
Only while the architect remains in the Philippines.

rationale.correct: Section 18 states that the Certificate of Registration remains in full force and effect until withdrawn, suspended, or revoked according to RA 9266. The prior cancellation-and-return scenario was not supported by the checked source.
